summary: Frontend-only verification of Dynopay /invoices redesign (Phase 2). Deep-tested the changed page end-to-end on desktop (1920) in light theme after real 2FA login. Receipts tab: new Console FilterBar renders with testid 'invoices-filter-bar' and 'invoices-search-input'; typing in search accepted. 10 invoice rows render; clicking invoice-row-10 opens 'invoice-preview-drawer' with 'invoice-preview-number', and 'invoice-preview-close' dismisses it (drawer unmounts). Tax tab (/invoices?tab=tax): new Console SummaryStrip renders with testid 'tax-summary-strip' and all three tiles (tax-stat-revenue, tax-stat-collected, tax-stat-invoices); tax-groupby-select, tax-print and the 'Tax by Period' table all present. No functional console errors from the invoices page itself. Dark-theme reload + mobile 390 verification was impacted by a Cloudflare bot-challenge interstitial that the preview served during subsequent navigations (see unclear items). Smoke pages (/payouts, /wallet, /developer-keys) returned missing root testids in this session — correlated with Cloudflare rate-limiting (dozens of 429s on _next JS chunks + ChunkLoadError for lazy sections), not a code regression. Per brief, did not re-run to avoid worsening the rate-limit.

unclear_items.detail: scrollWidth-clientWidth measured 402px on both /invoices and /invoices?tab=tax at viewport 390, BUT the mobile screenshot shows Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' interstitial (not the app). The overflow is almost certainly from the CF challenge page, not the Dynopay UI. Recommend re-running mobile check with a fresh session / real UA warm-up before considering it a real bug.

/payouts missing [data-testid=payouts-root], /developer-keys missing [data-testid=developers-tabs] in this session. Console shows many 429s loading _next chunks + ChunkLoadError '[DynamicFallback] lazy section failed to load'. This is Cloudflare rate-limiting the asset pipeline mid-session, not a code regression. /wallet URL loaded (no asserted testid).

action_items: No code changes needed for the Phase-2 invoices redesign — all required testids and behaviors verified on desktop light. If mobile layout is a concern, re-run a fresh session with CF warmed up to confirm there is no real overflow at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: Preview is behind Cloudflare and lazy-loaded _next chunks are being 429'd mid-session. This degrades testability (and real UX) when a user navigates several pages back-to-back. Consider warming/retrying the chunk loader or increasing CF allowance for /_next/* so DynamicFallback does not fall back to error state.
